hook.text: An app called GriefBot lets you text your dead grandmother. It responds using AI trained on her old messages.

buildup.text: Grief technology includes memorial websites, AI avatars, hologram concerts of dead musicians, and digital twins.

discovery.text: Studies show some bereaved users find AI chatbots comforting. Others find them deeply disturbing. Response is split.

twist.text: There are no regulations on grief tech. Anyone can scrape a dead person's data and create a chatbot without consent.

climax.text: Ancient cultures kept the dead present through ritual. We keep them present through software. Same instinct, new medium.

punchline.text: Technology didn't invent the need to keep talking to the dead.

quiz.question: What ethical issue surrounds grief chatbots?
